sonnet.problem: The statement joins two claims: the Philistines abandon their idols (true) and David and his men leave the idols where they lie (false). A baker can't tell which claim the card is testing.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.

sonnet.problem: The question says David is to "wait by the balsam trees behind the Philistines." Verse 23 tells him to circle around behind them and attack them in front of the balsam trees. Verse 24 tells him to move quickly when he hears the marching. The text never tells him to wait by the trees.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.
